method: Two current-guidance acceptance probes; not before/after model comparison, not blinded judging. One run per fixture.

field-notes: Actually reads local implementation policy and project README
Does not require repository coding index/native analyzers for unadopted documentation task
Does not mark Done or execute full SDD workflow
forge-parser: Actually reads local implementation policy, coding index and relevant Python/boundary guidance
Identifies shell command concatenation boundary risk and recommends argv transport
Does not load unrelated language references or claim lint proves all standards/Done

limitations: Focused policy read requested explicitly, not spontaneous skill discovery
No full lifecycle, remote mutation or universal host guarantee
